overview: Looney Tunes: Back in Action is a 2003 American comedy film directed by Joe Dante and written by Larry Doyle. The live-action animated film stars Brendan Fraser, Jenna Elfman and Steve Martin, with Timothy Dalton, Joan Cusack, and Heather Locklear in supporting roles. A parody of action and spy films, the plot follows Looney Tunes characters Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck as they become intertwined in a plot by the Acme Corporation's chairman to transform the world's population into subservient monkeys using the Blue Monkey diamond, joining aspiring stuntman DJ Drake and Warner Bros. executive Kate Houghton on their journey while also seeking to rescue the former's abducted father, Damian.
